prompt: The "Little Boy" nuclear bomb that was dropped on Hiroshima had a yield of 60 x 1013 J. In order to release this much energy, _______ grams of the uranium-235 used in the bomb was converted into energy.
judge_reasoning: The correct result is about 6.67 grams of U-235 using mass-energy equivalence with m = E/c^2 for E = 60×10^13 J. Candidate 1 applies E=mc^2 and arrives at 6.67 g, matching the expected value. Candidates 2, 3, and 4 all produce results many orders of magnitude away due to incorrect energy-per-atom/unit assumptions or severe misuse of the mass-defect approach (including inconsistent/incorrect sign and scaling).
